entities.summary: Takashi Azuma (b. 1949-05-22, Kesennuma) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kesennuma and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
